status: NORMATIVE_DRAFT — binding for the AUP-MIG-015 gate and for whatever AUP-MIG-016 consumes as its cutover precondition. The two documents defined here are the ONLY admissible outputs of the gate: an attestation when both verifiers PASS, a block receipt otherwise. There is no third, weaker output.
producer: tools/mig/data_gate/consume_data_gate.py (read-only; stdlib only; --selftest with a mutation battery)
purpose: Consume the AUP-DAT-020 data verdict at an exact revision and, SEPARATELY, verify the authority that permits a production/general cutoff. The two halves are joined only at the end and only by conjunction: a clean data verdict is a statement about data and never a permission.

authority_model.rule: Under DEC-AUP-0010 and DEC-AUP-0012 the `AuthorizationDecision` of AUP-E25 § MIG-015 (a human approval, DEC-AUP-0002) is REPLACED by a program decision with an evidence gate. The authority ref is therefore `decision id + the digests of its gate receipts`, never a person and never a signature.
authority_model.action: read from a versioned profile in the tool whose every assertion must be found verbatim in the decision or in a decision it incorporates by reference; an assertion that cannot be found is NOT_MEASURED and blocks
authority_model.expiry: the decision's `reverse_if` conditions, evaluated one by one; TRIGGERED ⇒ AUTHORITY_EXPIRED; a condition that only becomes measurable after a state the machine has not reached is typed NOT_YET_APPLICABLE and is neither pass nor fail
authority_model.revocation: any LATER decision whose `supersedes` / `supersedes_in_part` names this decision
authority_model.permitted_target_generation: the state machine of receipts/cutover/state.json must stand at or beyond `readiness_state_min` (ROLLBACK_DRILLED); no persisted state ⇒ the machine stands at FILES_AUTHORITATIVE and the cutover authority is not in effect
authority_model.separation_of_duties: the identity that signs the data half is compared against the authority issuer; equality is AUTHORITY_SIGNER_IS_DATA_SIGNER and blocks (spec: «Data signer не считается authority issuer»)

planes.rule: The gate reads active / planned / completed / cancelled, unindexed and conflicts through THREE planes. A plane that cannot answer is MISSING or UNKNOWN — never 'agrees'.
planes.files: occurrences read from git objects at the pinned SourceSetEpoch, classified through the HistoricalStatusMap revision OF RECORD
planes.muneral: the projections the work-item store actually holds (produced under the batch's map revision) plus its readback
planes.index: the KB/Scrutator freshness plane: what the history namespace acknowledges of those identities
planes.archived_row: `archived` is a row of its own and is NEVER folded into `completed` (DEC-AUP-0014 rule 3; I4 forbids the silent totalisation of an archive card into completion)
planes.classification: raw source values reach a class only through the versioned status map; the tool holds exactly one hand-written table (Muneral status → class) so it cannot invent a competing mapping. A raw value absent from the map is a typed UNMAPPED refusal, never a default.

refs.rule: exactly two refs, one of kind `data` and one of kind `authority`; a one-ref attestation is invalid

writer_epoch.invariant: `changed` MUST be false — AUP-MIG-015 mints no authority and never changes the writer epoch (spec: «не меняет writer»); a document claiming otherwise is invalid under this contract

fields.negative_verdicts: every check that did not PASS, with its verifier, tri-valued verdict, reason code, question and detail — carried on the ATTESTATION too, so a PASS never hides what was merely not measured

data.DOSSIER_REVISION_UNPINNED: the dossier is not pinned to an exact, resolvable revision
data.DOSSIER_NOT_CLEAN: the dossier's own verdict is not PASS / not globally complete
data.UNPINNED_SOURCE_SET_EPOCH: the SourceSetEpoch is not git-pinned to a workspace commit
data.EPOCH_DOSSIER_MISMATCH: the epoch is not the corpus the dossier measured
data.STALE_SOURCE_SET_EPOCH: the source set has moved past the pinned epoch — DAT-020/MIG-015 are invalidated and require revalidation
data.SOURCE_SET_HEAD_NOT_OBSERVED: no observation of the source-set head was available (not measured)
data.MISSING_PLANE: a plane cannot answer for the status classes
data.PLANE_DISAGREEMENT: the planes disagree on a status class
data.PLANE_COMPARISON_INCOMPLETE: fewer than three planes could be compared (not measured)
data.UNMAPPED_STATUS_VALUE: a raw or projected status value has no entry in the mapping of record
data.MAPPING_REVISION_BEHIND_RECORD: the store projects under a superseded status-map revision
data.MAPPING_REVISION_NOT_MEASURED: the store's or the record's map revision could not be read
data.UNINDEXED_NOT_MEASURED: the number of unindexed identities cannot be established
data.CONFLICTS_PLANE_MISSING: held conflicts are not visible through all three planes (not measured)
data.BYTE_COPY_UNPROVEN: no snapshot/readback receipt proves the byte copy
data.RESTORE_NOT_MEASURED: no restore of the target store has been drilled — a backup that was never restored is not a backup
data.CLEAN_READ_THROUGH_MISSING: no clean-path probe for a host role
data.CLEAN_READ_THROUGH_NOT_DECLARED: the probe ran without declaring a clean read-through
data.HIDDEN_MOUNT_OR_CACHE: a source mount or cache was present on a probed host

authority.AUTHORITY_DECISION_MISSING: the authorising decision does not exist
authority.AUTHORITY_SCOPE_NOT_CONFIRMED: an action/resource/target-generation assertion of the profile is not found in the decision closure (not measured)
authority.AUTHORITY_SIGNER_IS_DATA_SIGNER: the data signer and the authority issuer are the same identity
authority.AUTHORITY_REVOKED: a later decision supersedes the authorising decision
authority.AUTHORITY_EXPIRED: a `reverse_if` condition of the decision has fired
authority.AUTHORITY_EXPIRY_NOT_MEASURED: a `reverse_if` condition has no probe (not measured)
authority.AUTHORITY_STATE_UNINITIALISED: the cutover state machine has no persisted state
authority.AUTHORITY_NOT_IN_EFFECT: the state machine has not reached the state this attestation presupposes
authority.AUTHORITY_EVIDENCE_GATE_INCOMPLETE: one or more evidence-gate items of the decision are unsatisfied
authority.AUTHORITY_EVIDENCE_GATE_NOT_MEASURED: one or more evidence-gate items have no probe

invariants: never a PASS by default: the verdict is PASS only if EVERY check answered PASS and at least one check ran
NOT_MEASURED is a third verdict and never opens the gate
an attestation is minted only when the data verifier AND the authority verifier both PASS
the attestation carries two refs; a data ref alone is not an attestation
`writer_epoch.changed` is false in every document this contract admits
the gate is read-only: its only writes are its own receipts
rollback: AUP-E25 § MIG-015: withdraw the attestation, keep the new-work freeze and owner-controlled legacy writes until revalidation. Withdrawal is itself a receipt: a later block receipt over the same portion supersedes an earlier attestation.
not_measured_by_this_contract: whether the imported historical `done` values are true (I14: asserted, never verified here)
the semantics of the source documents behind the status values
any host, service or repository state that is not already carried by a receipt on program main
